author.name: Data Dave
author.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

challenge.name: The Inconsistent Checks
challenge.description: #data_dave# insists on keeping the quality checks manually done to control costs. #reliability_ruth# argues for full automation to ensure consistent results.

output.content: We need to balance the push for full automation with the reality of our budget. I am willing to accept a hybrid approach where we automate the core pipeline steps but keep the final data quality checks manual for now. This compromise lets us leverage open source tools to reduce infrastructure spend without hiring additional staff to maintain complex automated validation suites. If we insist on automating every single check, we will burn through our quarterly allocation on licensing and engineering hours before the model even reaches production. I can live with a few hours of human review per week if it means we stay under the cost ceiling and avoid overhauling the entire storage layer to support real time monitoring.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept a hybrid approach and can live with manual checks, indicating they are giving up full automation to preserve the budget.
